Waste Collection Calendar

The City's waste collection calendar is distributed annually to Barrie residents. It contains information about residential municipal waste collection including maps, schedules, and waste collection tips.

 

Be sure to place materials curbside by 7am on your collection day. Collectors complete routes between 7am and 6pm. If items are not curbside by 7am, there is no guarantee they will be collected.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

Residential recycling is not managed by the City of Barrie. An organization called Circular Materials is responsible for collecting residential recycling in Barrie and has their own contract with Emterra, including recycling-related promotion, education, and customer service. For recycling information, including collection schedules and accepted materials, residents are encouraged to visit the Circular Materials website for the most up-to-date information.
